The full record isfree with an accountor through the [API](https://indexed.vc/docs/api). ## About Doxis (formerly SER Group, rebranded January 2026) is a global enterprise content management (ECM) software provider headquartered in Bonn, Germany, serving over 3,000 customers and 5 million users worldwide with more than 900 employees. The company delivers AI-first Document Intelligence, combining document management, AI, and process automation to help enterprises gather, analyze, manage, and automate their entire document lifecycle. Doxis has been recognized as a Gartner Leader in the ECM/content services category. Summary It lists 201–500 employees. Its most recent funding was a Private Equity round in Mar 2024.
